away.name: John Gibson
away.news: Gibson has missed a week with a lower-body injury, but he will return to the crease on Tuesday. The 33-year-old Gibson nearly single-handedly led the Red Wings to the playoffs last season before falling just short, but he has struggled to start the 2026-27 campaign. Gibson has an ugly 3.46 GAA and .860 SV% in 11 appearances this season (4-5-1), and has allowed three or more goals six times. The Red Wings enter Tuesday's contest as +124 road underdogs against a Blues team that defeated them 5-4 less than two weeks ago.

home.name: Joel Hofer
home.news: Hofer has been reliable on most nights, earning his share of the crease and making veteran Jordan Binnington the clear-cut backup goalie in St. Louis. The 26-year-old Hofer is coming off a solid outing, saving 26 of 28 shots (.929 SV%), but lost 3-1 to the Nashville Predators. Goal support has been a recurring issue for Hofer lately, as the Blues have only scored four goals combined in his last three losses, despite him saving 142 of 155 shots (.916 SV%). The Blues enter Tuesday's game as -138 home favourites against a Detroit Red Wings team that has only scored three goals combined in their last three games (0-3-0).

away.name: Juuse Saros
away.news: Saros led the Predators onto the ice for warmups.

home.name: Anton Forsberg
home.news: Darcy Kuemper struggled last season, leading the Kings to rely on Forsberg toward the end of the season and into the playoffs, creating uncertainty heading into 2026-27. That said, the Kings have relied on Kuemper to start the season, despite Forsberg's solid play. The 33-year-old Forsberg has yet to win in six appearances (0-4-1), but has been solid, allowing two or fewer goals four times. He has a 2.51 GAA and a .902 SV%. The Kings enter Tuesday's game as -125 home favourites against the Nashville Predators, who are riding a four-game winning streak.
